label: A concrete thing that begins to be present has a concrete ground present at its absence or later
paraphrase: OPEN analyst premise, attribution deferred: in every history of the model, a concrete individual that is absent at a moment s and present at a strictly later moment has some concrete individual as a ground under that history's grounding relation that is present in that history at s or at some moment strictly after s. Existential: other grounds, including remote ones that ceased before s, are unconstrained. The ground need not be a sufficient or deterministic cause, and its existence in the history is not asserted (presence-to-existence is a separate premise). Things present from the earliest moment of their history, and things never present, are unconstrained. Intended sense of ground: the proximate ground of the thing's coming to be, per se or per accidens; the derivation holds for any relation.
